title: Taiwan to Pay Tourists to Visit Again
paragraphs: Many countries want tourists to visit them. But Taiwan wants tourists to come back again, and it is offering money to make this happen.

In June 2026, Taiwan's Tourism Administration announced a new program for foreign visitors who come to Taiwan again. Under the program, visitors who have been to Taiwan before can get NT$5,000, or about US$157, in travel credit. If they bring a friend who is visiting Taiwan for the first time in a while, they can get NT$3,000 more. In total, they can get up to NT$8,000.

The program started on October 1, 2026, and it is for travelers who enter Taiwan between October 10, 2026, and March 31, 2027. To take part, visitors must have been to Taiwan at least once since January 1, 2023. However, not everyone will get the money, because winners are chosen in a lottery. The program will end when all the money runs out.

The program is open to all international travelers, but it is mainly aimed at tourists from Japan. Japan is one of Taiwan's most important tourism markets in the world. In 2025, about 1.48 million Japanese tourists visited Taiwan, an increase of more than 12% from the year before.

Taiwan hopes to welcome 9.4 million foreign tourists in 2026. The government is also promoting different areas of Taiwan, so that visitors can enjoy many kinds of places and activities. Paul Shih, an official at the Tourism Administration, said the plan is about "promoting varying combinations of experiences."
